message: 意味
The Demons have been growing in number and steadily getting stronger. On top of that, they've been showing up at Ryuusei Academy with alarming frequency.
What could the reason be? If I look out over the academy from the hill, I might find some kind of clue.

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, say cheese」

name: Azel
message: 「'Cheese' is the name of a dairy product. I am not cheese.」
In the plaza on the hill, Melilot-san had her camera ready and was trying to take a picture of Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「In this case, 'cheese' just means to give a big smile.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hello, Sakura-kun. It's a lovely day for a photoshoot, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you're teaming up with Melilot-san for a photo session, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Incorrect」

name: Azel
message: 「This woman merely appeared uninvited, carrying a contraption that takes pictures.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Does having your picture taken make you uncomfortable?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not dislike it」

name: Azel
message: 「However, while I understand the concept of 'cheese,' I cannot agree to it. If I were to put on a fake smile, the photograph would fail to capture the truth.」

name: Melilot
message: 「You do have a point there.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, here I go.」
Azel's eyes darted around. Caught off guard, he must have been at a loss for where to look.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ready」
The instant Melilot―san pressed the shutter button―
The lens popped off and a toy mouse sprang out, bonking Azel right on the forehead.

name: Azel
message: 「What is the meaning of this?」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's a joke.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not a joke」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft! Hahaha... ahahahahaha!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you laugh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, do you know what a joke is?」

name: Azel
message: 「I understand it. A joke is a jest, idle chatter, frivolous talk, a playful anecdote, or a comical matter」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not understanding, that's just the definition. Ahahahahaha」

name: Azel
message: 「They are the same」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, they're not. Ahh, that's hilarious」

name: Azel
message: 「This woman's series of actions does not qualify as a joke. Even so, why do you laugh?」

name: Synn
message: 「It was just so funny seeing Melilot-san miss the mark, the weird silence after the mouse hit and fell to the ground, and your back-and-forth with her」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh, analyzing it killed the laugh...」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's definitely a lie」

name: Azel
message: 「I am telling you that I understood」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh... Melilot-san, did you follow Azel all the way here just to pull that off?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No good. Picturing how that went is making me laugh all over again... pfft, hahaha」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something like that. Helena foisted a prank camera onto me, and I was at a loss for how to deal with it」

name: Azel
message: 「And so why come to me? You wish to be in the library, do you not?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because you are fascinating」

name: Azel
message: 「Go home」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, why did you come here?」

name: Azel
message: 「Because I wished to come」

name: Melilot
message: 「In order to do as you please whenever you please, you need someone to whom you can entrust your affairs, do you not?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you have such a person?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I do」

name: Azel
message: 「It's that chairwoman, isn't it!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why are you getting mad?」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Azel
message: 「Whatever you try to do with that woman, it's pointless」

name: Melilot
message: 「On the surface, that is correct」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, Helena and I share a bond like the soul and heart of a single body. We were originally one, so parting has no bearing on us」

name: Melilot
message: 「All that fills my heart is concern for Helena. I am ashamed of myself for possessing only such a narrow love」

name: Azel
message: 「For all your preaching to me, aren't you nothing more than that woman's shadow guard in the end!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is enough. Only with Helena am I truly fulfilled」

name: Melilot
message: 「What about you, Azel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「In my own way, I am quite fond of you as well」
Azel looks at my face. I want to say something to him as a friend.
However, their conversation leaves out some huge subject, and I have no clue what it could be.

name: Melilot
message: 「It's a joke.」

name: Azel
message: 「I still cannot smile」
Melilot takes another picture of Azel with the prank camera.

name: Azel
message: 「I do not understand. That joke is no joke at all」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, you. Tell a joke」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!? A-All of a sudden?」

name: Azel
message: 「People are always laughing around you」

name: Synn
message: 「Smiles aren't expressions that only come from jokes, though... uhh...」

name: Synn
message: 「'How many cans of juice did you get?' 'Just ten, man'」

name: Azel
message: 「I see, I understand」

name: Azel
message: 「'The balance beam is scary, isn't it?' 'I'm totally balanced'」

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you not laughing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee」

name: Azel
message: 「You laughed」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san. You and Sakura-kun may be running parallel right now, but I'm sure your paths will cross someday」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't understand」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee, well then, I shall heed your warning and return to the library」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you come to bother me too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, I just wanted to look at the scenery for a bit」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Same as me」

name: Synn
message: 「Should I come back later if I'm in the way?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't worry about it」
I look out over Ryuusei Academy from the hill. Rather than looking at the wharf or Finis Tower, Azel shifts his gaze to match mine.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, look, look! Sacchin just came out of Prier. He has a really distinctive walk, so I can tell right away」

name: Azel
message: 「You can see people clearly from up here」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, though you can't make out their expressions」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm fine right here. If I climb any higher, it'll be too blinding to see anyone or anything at all」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean the glare of the sun?」

name: Azel
message: 「Incorrect」

name: Azel
message: 「...What do you see that brightness as? An evil light that destroys everything, or the hand of God that purifies all?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't know」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't know either」
For a while, I stand side by side with Azel, looking down at the academy after school.
In the end, I couldn't get a read on the Demon's movements.
